'''Keons''' were curious, [[Rodent/Legends|rodent]]-like [[marsupial]]s, that had an ability to mimic sounds. This ability allowed the [[Species/Legends|creature]] to repeat words uttered in the vicinity, though at a higher pitch. Keons flicked their tails back and forth, perked up their ears, and gazed with their huge eyes to show curiosity. They had four digits on each [[Bird/Legends|birdlike]] [[Limb/Legends|forefoot]]. The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Ramsey Lanclo]] kept a [[Gender/Legends|female]] as a pet for a few weeks, although he did not have the proper permit and license to do so. The creature cost him 1,500 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], and he gave it to [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial Office of Customs/Legends|Customs]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] [[Hewat]], in order to distract her from searching his cargo, a large amount of [[Glitterstim/Legends|glitterstim]]. She in turn gave it to her daughter, [[Kora]], who lived on [[Yityl]].<ref name="CFTD" />
